summary: y⁻¹f_a = (sy)⁻¹(s f_a) and s f_a lies in the span of the frame.

steps.lean:
ext i
  simpa [mul_comm (frameMatrix ..), frameVector, mul_apply] using!
    congrFun₂ (submatrix_mul_besselFrame hs (y⁻¹ * s⁻¹) id) i a
steps.claim: Coordinatewise: y⁻¹f_a = (sy)⁻¹·(s f_a), and for s ∈ 𝖴 the frame columns of (sy)⁻¹s are the frame columns of (sy)⁻¹ times frameMatrix(s) (submatrix_mul_besselFrame), i.e. s f_a = Σ_b frameMatrix(s)_{ba} f_b.
